groups.sentence: Instructors set AI limits that mirror those likely to apply in students' post-graduation professional settings.
The course's skills and learning outcomes prepare students for their future career and success in their degree.
Developing strong competencies in this area prepares students for a competitive workplace.
Relying on AI as a shortcut or outsourcing thinking leaves students less prepared, with less learning and weaker future prospects.
The university's goal is to prepare students for a career in industry, including problems AI cannot solve.
Students should become competent enough to surpass generative AI in the future, in academia, research and the workplace.
Professional settings may not give immediate access to AI and have varied norms and strict rules on AI use.
Many industries require professionals to document AI-assisted work, and transparent use is part of AI fluency.
